corrected_claim: UBS agreed to buy Credit Suisse for CHF 3 billion (US$3.2 billion) in an all-stock deal announced 19 March 2023. CS had closed around CHF 1.86 (~US$2.03) on Friday 17 Mar, market cap ~US$8bn. Initial media reports cited ~US$1-2bn before the confirmed US$3.2bn (at CHF 0.76 per share, a ~59% discount). On Monday 20 Mar 2023 CS shares FELL roughly 50-60% (deal priced at CHF 0.76 vs Friday close CHF 1.86); they did not trade 7% higher after the deal.

corrected_claim: Fitch did downgrade the US sovereign rating from AAA to AA+ on 1 Aug 2023 (first downgrade since S&P's 2011 action). However the Nifty reaction was NOT a ~700-point single-day fall from 20,000: Nifty closed 19,733 on 1 Aug 2023, fell ~207 pts (-1.05%) to 19,526.55 on 2 Aug, then another ~145 pts (-0.74%) to 19,381.65 on 3 Aug (intraday low 19,296.45). Nifty was not at 20,000 (first crossed 20,000 only in Sept 2023). Total two-session fall ~350 pts from ~19,730. US Dow fell three consecutive sessions (2-4 Aug 2023), cumulatively ~565 pts.

BJP won 240 seats (failed to cross 272) and depended on TDP (Chandrababu Naidu) and JDU (Nitish Kumar) allies - correct.
